title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Hard Rock Live, Hollywood | 2022
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at Hard Rock Live, situated at the Seminole Hard Rock Hollywood in Hollywood, Florida, USA, on 17 September 2022.

It was the 19th show of the 15th All-Starr Band’s 2022 tour of North America, which lasted for 30 dates between May and October 2022.

Starr previously performed at the Hard Rock Live on 3 July 2008, 15 July 2010, and 30 June 2012. He returned there on 20 June 2025. Paul McCartney also performed at the venue on 25 May 2022.

The 15th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Edgar Winter: vocals, keyboards, saxophone
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet
